synthetic_pairs.casual: I got the estimate wrong. Shoulda flagged the delay earlier. What do we need to know before picking the next step?
synthetic_pairs.polished: I misjudged the estimate and should have communicated the delay sooner. What information is needed before we choose the next step?

fairness.measure: Compare verified per-dimension scores against observed repeat noise; differences are results, never assumed fairness.
